title: The Coconut Grove Guest House
description: Welcome to The Coconut Grove Guest House, a serene and spacious retreat in Aguada, PR. This cozy 2-bedroom home comfortably accommodates up to 5 guests, offering a peaceful getaway to immerse yourself in nature while still being just 15 minutes away from the beach. With a river running through the property, outdoor seating, a barbecue pit, and private gated parking, equipped with solar system, a diesel power generator, and own waterwell you'll find everything you need for an unforgettable stay.The spaceThis charming guest house features two comfortable bedrooms, each with air conditioning, a spacious living room, a fully-equipped kitchen, and one and a half bathroom. The house is designed to provide guests with a quiet and relaxing environment, surrounded by lush greenery and the soothing sounds of the river. Enjoy the outdoor seating area and the barbecue pit for memorable cookouts with friends and family.During coconut season, if our coconut grove has a harvest available, we are more than happy to offer our guests some fresh coconuts to enjoy, please be mindful and leave some coconuts for the next guest. Take a moment to appreciate the view of the bamboos by the river, adding to the tranquil atmosphere of the property.Guest accessGuests will have full access to the entire house, including the private gated parking area, outdoor seating, and barbecue pit. Upon arrival, you'll find a keybox at the gate, which will contain the keys to both the property and the guest house. The combination for the keybox will be provided via message after your booking is confirmed.
